summary: user password takes a hash on Linux (written to /etc/shadow unvalidated; '!' or '*' locks) and plaintext on macOS (always reports changed). Also covers password expiry: account disable days, max and min days.
questions: How do I set a user's password with Ansible?
Should I pass a plaintext or hashed password to the user module?
How do I create a user with a locked password?
Why does the user task always show changed on macOS?
How do I force password changes every 90 days?

answer_card.title: user password and expiry
answer_card.answer_md:
- `password`: Linux needs a **hash** (e.g. `{{ 'pw' | password_hash('sha512') }}`), written to `/etc/shadow` without validation. `'!'` or `'*'` locks (OpenBSD: `'*************'`). macOS takes **cleartext** and always reports changed.
- `password_expire_max` / `password_expire_min` (Linux)
- `password_expire_account_disable`: days after expiry until disabled
